name: Wo Ba Shi Nan Niang
source:
This is a near-future society where the environment has gone to hell.

Men die of Y-Erosion Syndrome once they turn forty.

A man's only choices are death—or becoming a femboy...

Bull and Jim are a father and son who have only each other.

Bull used to say he'd rather die a real man than ever become a femboy...

But can Jim really leave his unconscious father to sleep and never wake?

Death, or becoming a femboy.

There's only one fate waiting for the old man.

[From [url=https://popelephant.itch.io/my-dad-is-a-femboy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个生态环境彻底恶化的近未来社会。

男性一旦年满四十岁，就会死于“对Y侵蚀症”。

男人们面前只有两条路可走：死亡——或者变成男娘……

老牛和大志是一对相依为命的父子。

老牛过去总把一句话挂在嘴边：宁可堂堂正正死成一条汉子，也绝不变成男娘……

可面对昏迷不醒的父亲，大志真的忍心眼睁睁看着他一睡不醒吗？

是死，还是变成男娘。

等待着老爷子的命运只有一个。

[摘自[url=https://popelephant.itch.io/my-dad-is-a-femboy]itch.io[/url]]
